headline_item.title_zh: 全球高校反AI运动：学术自主权的博弈
headline_item.title_en: The Anti-A.I. Campus Movement Is Growing
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 全球多地高校师生通过请愿与抗议，抵制AI工具引入教学，诉求保障学术自主与人类创造力价值
headline_item.event_summary_en: University students and faculty globally are protesting the integration of generative AI through petitions, religious exemption filings, and manifestos. The movement seeks to curtail institutional partnerships with AI vendors like OpenAI and Google, citing concerns over the erosion of critical thinking and the intrinsic value of human-centric education.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】高校学生与教授群体（如特兰西瓦尼亚大学抗议学生）在全球高校（如美国、澳大利亚、法国）：要求取消AI工具授权、拒绝强制使用AI教学及寻求作业豁免权
【起因与机理】担忧AI破坏教学本质、削弱劳动力价值及版权隐私隐患
【核心事实细节】师生群体发起抵制AI教学工具的集体行动。
【各方立场与态度】抗争逻辑基于对知识获取过程退化的伦理焦虑。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] University students and faculty members (Global academic institutions): Demanding cessation of AI software licenses and rights to opt-out of AI-integrated coursework
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Concerns over the loss of critical struggle in learning and ethical risks
[Key Fact Detail] Collective resistance against AI pedagogical adoption.
[Key Position & Outlook] Ethical concerns regarding the degradation of the learning process.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 高校端的AI阻力反映了技术渗透与传统教学范式之间的深层结构性矛盾，未来教育产业将面临‘人本教育’与‘AI辅助化’的长期价值阵营撕裂。这种运动短期内难以动摇大厂商业化布局，但将倒逼教育科技企业转向更透明、可控的辅助型工具设计。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The academic resistance highlights a structural friction between AI integration and traditional pedagogical paradigms, signaling a long-term schism in education between human-centric ideals and automated assistance. While unlikely to halt enterprise-level AI adoption, this pressure will force EdTech providers to pivot toward more transparent and controllable, human-in-the-loop tool architectures.

headlines.title_zh: 北美工业机器人订单激增，制造自动化加速
headlines.title_en: US companies turn to robots to ease labour shortage crisis
headlines.event_summary_zh: 受制造业回流与劳动力短缺驱动，北美Q3机器人订单同比激增25%，协作机器人成为增长核心
headlines.event_summary_en: North American manufacturers are accelerating robot adoption to mitigate severe labor shortages, with Q3 2026 orders reaching 11,000 units, a 25% year-on-year increase. Notably, orders for collaborative robots (cobots) surged by 56%, serving as a critical lever for firms to scale output amid persistent workforce limitations.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】自动驾驶自动化协会（A3）、Agility机器人公司在北美制造业市场：Q3订单增长25%，协作机器人需求激增56%
【起因与机理】劳动力老龄化、制造业回流政策及用工成本上涨
【关键数据与实测】北美制造业正通过大规模采购工业机器人解决长期劳动力缺口，自动驾驶自动化协会报告显示，2026年Q3机器人订单量达1.1万台，同比增速25%。
【各方立场与态度】制造业通过自动化而非新建厂房挖掘存量产能。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Association for Advancing Automation (A3), Agility Robotics: Q3 orders up 25%, with a 56% spike in collaborative robot demand
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Aging workforce, reshoring incentives, and rising labor costs
[Key Metrics] North American manufacturers are accelerating robot adoption to mitigate severe labor shortages, with Q3 2026 orders reaching 11,000 units, a 25% year-on-year increase.
[Key Position & Outlook] Manufacturers prioritize unlocking latent capacity through automation over new facility expansion.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 制造业自动化已跨过‘重资产投入’的门槛，进入由‘协作机器人’与‘虚拟环境预训练’驱动的规模化部署周期。这种趋势表明，企业已放弃单纯依靠人口红利，转而通过释放现有设施的潜在生产力来应对宏观贸易环境的不确定性。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Industrial automation has crossed the threshold from high-capex investments to a scaling cycle driven by cobots and virtual environment pre-training. This shift indicates that manufacturers are moving away from dependency on labor arbitrage, focusing instead on unlocking latent capacity in existing facilities to hedge against macroeconomic volatility.

headlines.title_zh: 谷歌投资150亿美元扩建密苏里数据中心
headlines.title_en: Google Ruth Porat Pledges Data Center Local Support Amid Backlash
headlines.event_summary_zh: 谷歌计划在密苏里州投资150亿美元建设数据中心，并配套能源基础设施以保障电网容量
headlines.event_summary_en: Alphabet and Google President Ruth Porat announced a $15 billion investment in data center infrastructure in Missouri. The central project, 'Project Spade' in Montgomery County, targets a 1.2GW capacity. To address energy needs, Google is partnering with utility providers Ameren and Evergy to secure 500MW of additional grid capacity while utilizing a Capacity Commitment Framework (CCF) to protect local rate payers.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Alphabet/Google（Ruth Porat），密苏里州政府（Mike Kehoe）在密苏里州蒙哥马利县：投入150亿美元建设1.2GW数据中心，并引入新增电力产能
【起因与机理】满足AI基建扩张需求并缓解当地电价舆论压力
【关键数据与实测】150亿美元投向大型数据中心集群开发。
【各方立场与态度】通过Capacity Commitment Framework规避电力价格波动舆情。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Alphabet/Google (Ruth Porat), Governor Mike Kehoe (Montgomery County, Missouri): $15 billion investment for a 1.2GW data center project with grid capacity expansion
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Scaling AI infrastructure while mitigating local energy cost concerns
[Key Metrics] $15B capital allocation for hyperscale data center infrastructure.
[Key Position & Outlook] Implementation of CCF framework to mitigate local electricity price volatility concerns.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 大厂自建算力基建的合规成本已从单一的环境评价转向能源供给的社会责任共担。谷歌通过CCF框架介入区域电力分配，实质是试图建立‘算力与能源协同共生’的模式，以对冲未来能源紧张导致的监管与社区阻力。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Compliance costs for hyperscale data centers are shifting from environmental impact to a social-economic bargain over grid capacity. By adopting the CCF framework, Google is pioneering a 'computational-energy symbiosis' model to mitigate regulatory and community backlash, securing its license to operate in an era of energy scarcity.

celebrity.author: Aravind Srinivas
celebrity.quote_zh:
过去几天，我们推出了三个新的 API：
困惑监视器：事件可编程警报
Perplexity Orchestrator：跨边界和开放权重模型的基于任务的路由
Perplexity Context：从 URL 到代理可用内容的批处理模式转换

我们的 API 业务同比增长了 4.3 倍，年运行率达到 9 位数。 Perplexity 拥有最先进的网络搜索、决策模型（在 Openrouter 上增长最快）以及法学硕士和决策模型的搜索基础。我们才刚刚开始。关注@perplexitydevs 进行定期更新。
celebrity.quote_en:
Last few days, we launched three new APIs: 
Perplexity Monitor: programmable alerts on events
Perplexity Orchestrator: task based routing across frontier and open-weight models  
Perplexity Context: batch-mode transformation from URLs to usable content for agents 

Our API business has grown 4.3x YoY and tracks at a 9-figure annual run rate. Perplexity has the state-of-the-art web search, decision models (fastest growing on Openrouter), and search grounding for LLMs and decision models. We’re just getting started. Follow @perplexitydevs for regular updates.

titans.name: OpenAI 官方
titans.role_zh: OpenAI 官方发布与模型前沿
titans.event_context_zh:
何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

我们希望这份扩展报告将有助于维持和推进整个行业的共享衡量规范。
titans.event_context_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponent
titans.quote_zh:
我们正在 OpenAI 上分享有关人工智能如何改变研究的新数据。

我们发现研究人员对人工智能的使用持续呈指数级增长，智能体正在完成更长的任务，但人类的参与仍然是研究的核心。研究人员也在安全和协调上花费了更多的时间，人类在这些领域的努力比任何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

我们希望这份扩展报告将有助于维持和推进整个行业的共享衡量规范。
titans.quote_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponentially, and agents are completing longer tasks, but human involvement remains central in research. Researchers are also spending more time on safety and alignment, with human effort in these areas growing faster than in any other individual research area.

This report aims to increase transparency around research acceleration and inform the governance of increasingly capable AI. We believe that AI labs should be required to track and publicly report indicators of recursive self-improvement (RSI): the process by which AI accelerates the development of future AI systems. 

Our hope is that this expanded report will help sustain and advance shared measurement norms across the industry.

https://t.co/xyGPcCkPCK
